questions.text: Where in your life do you feel you need more strength right now?
questions.verse_text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

questions.text: When you feel weak, how do you usually respond?
questions.verse_text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me.

questions.text: Is there something you're facing that feels too big for you?
questions.verse_text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

questions.text: What gives you courage when you're afraid?
questions.verse_text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.

questions.text: Can you think of a time when you were stronger than you thought you could be?
questions.verse_text: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

questions.text: What would you attempt if you truly believed God was fighting for you?
questions.verse_text: The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.

questions.text: Is there a battle you've been fighting alone that you need to surrender to God?
questions.verse_text: And he said, Hearken ye, all Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, and thou king Jehoshaphat, Thus saith the LORD unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God's.

questions.text: How do you maintain courage when the situation doesn't change?
questions.verse_text: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

questions.text: What does it mean to you that God's power is made perfect in weakness?
questions.verse_text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

questions.text: Would you like to receive strength from Scripture for your battle?
questions.verse_text: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
